goal: Resolve Android/Termux background-image MKV progress after page refresh and improve HSR subtitle Layout/Effects studio using the user's two portrait/landscape screen recordings as real-world evidence.

current_bounded_work_unit.name: Reconnect existing MKV job on browser reload; drain FFmpeg stderr; bound subtitle time display

findings: Effect studio first viewport is consumed by cue display timing and parameter controls; media preview is not continuously visible while editing.
Cue start/end inputs expose excessively long floating point seconds (e.g., 40.48533333333333).
Long, read-only source and translated text take substantial vertical space; repeated scrolling disconnects controls from visual effect.
Preview and Inspector coexist, but dense bilingual rendered text takes most of the visual stage; poor space for legibility evaluation.
Inspector controls dominate height and contain repeated similarly weighted operations; editing text can be far from the preview.
Horizontal/tablet composition should prioritize stage, adjust inspector width, and preserve artifact/preview status near its action.

supported_root_causes: After page reload refresh() read /api/status once and renderJobs(s.jobs), but never reattached watchJob(ongoing.id); a frozen page-visible progress value does not by itself demonstrate backend FFmpeg halted.

ArchiveBundleExporter invoked Popen with stdout=PIPE and stderr=PIPE, drained stdout to EOF before reading stderr; a full stderr pipe can block FFmpeg. This is a real possibility, not proven to be the exact device freeze cause.
Time input rendering used String(raw_float), exposing binary timeline fractions without formatting.
completed_units: WU-01 source-level fix: reconnect in-flight job by existing id with single-poll guard and stale-progress warning, no new export side effect
WU-01 source-level fix: FFmpeg stderr goes to bounded-lifecycle temporary file, eliminating unread pipe backpressure
WU-01 source-level fix: display cue input times with at most 3 fractional digits, retain precise underlying timing until explicit edit

next_units.goal: Studio composition: viewport/responsive stage–inspector–cue hierarchy; maintain actual 16:9 preview and essential status visible during portrait and tablet interaction, avoid keyboard occlusion, no regression to cue editing
Layout inspector simplification: prioritize font, size, gap, safe area, preview, save; convert advanced technical settings to progressive disclosure; strengthen overflow/scale feedback on the canvas
Effects authoring: separate dynamic video preview, effect parameters, save and export; accessible controls and feedback with real FFmpeg/libass evidence

Android physical device: reproduce image-to-MKV export, refresh mid-encode, confirm same task id continues and completes, stable output/receipt and usable playback; verify portrait and landscape with fresh screenshots

blockers: No access to user's live Termux process or logs; on-device cause for reported freeze cannot be isolated beyond identified software defects.
Project-level visual acceptance requires browser/device screenshot after changes.
